name: Pennant of the Champion
body:
Price 10,000 gp; Aura moderate enchantment; CL 5; Weight 0.5 lb.

DESCRIPTION

This crimson pennant can be affixed to a hafted polearm. When attached to a hafted polearm with the reach special quality its power activates granting a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls for all allies within 60 feet. In addition if the wielder of the polearm has a smite or challenge class feature they gain an additional use per day of that ability and the first time each day they successfully deal damage with one of those abilities they deal additional damage equal to their character level.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 5,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells prayer
